ongoing.title: Thinking and Working Mathematically
ongoing.blurb: Cambridge sets eight characteristics, working as four pairs, to be developed through every unit rather than taught on their own. Plan for at least one of them in each lesson.

items.title: Specialising and Generalising: trying particular cases, then seeing what is always true
Conjecturing and Convincing: forming a hypothesis, then presenting evidence for it
Characterising and Classifying: naming the properties of an object, then sorting by them
Critiquing and Improving: comparing methods, then making one better
